subset: 70 evenly spaced filenames per sequence, 11 sequences, 770 frames
group: subject S1/S2/S3 inferred from source filename; never split a participant
mapping_basis: source annotation groups and manual visual check of centered examples; source release has no class-name file
protocol: leave-one-participant-out; fixed parameters; random-frame split and shuffled-label control only as diagnostics
uncertainty: report all three participant folds; no frame-independent confidence interval
